Bright & Spacious 3BR/2.5BA Upper Unit | ~1,500 Sq Ft | Covered Parking | In-Unit Laundry
DESCRIPTION
Spacious and light-filled 3BD / 2.5BA upper unit offering approximately 1,500 sq. ft. of living space in a completely freestanding duplex, with private covered parking included.
Unlike many San Francisco flats, the duplex has no building directly adjoining it on any side, providing exceptional natural light, windows on multiple sides, and excellent privacy.
The home features three bedrooms, including two large bedrooms, each with its own private en-suite full bathroom. The primary bedroom also has a large walk-in closet. A separate half bath off the formal living room is ideal for guests.
The kitchen and pantry also offer direct access to a private patio leading to the side yard. The side entrance provides convenient pull-up access, allowing you to bring groceries and other items directly into the pantry/kitchen rather than carrying them through the main entrance.
With hardwood floors, generous room sizes, abundant windows, private parking, in-unit laundry, and a thoughtful floor plan, this upper unit offers the space and conveniences of a private home.
